## Descriptivos


####Librería

```{r}

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, 
               dplyr, 
               haven, 
               car, 
               magrittr,
               psych,
               readxl, 
               fastDummies,
               stargazer,
               modelsummary,
               summarytools,
               dplyr, lme4, sjPlot, webshot2, htmltools, officer, lmerTest, here, pandoc, fixest)

```

####Bases de datos

```{r}

CIVED_1999 <- readRDS("../output/data_procesada/proc_CIVED_1999.rds")

ICCS_2009 <- readRDS("../output/data_procesada/proc_ICCS_2009.rds")

ICCS_2016 <- readRDS("../output/data_procesada/proc_ICCS_2016.rds")

PACES_2019 <- readRDS("../output/data_procesada/proc_PACES_2019.rds")

```

### Grafico de crecimiento

```{r}

promedios_voto <- data.frame(
  base = c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019"),
  promedio = c(
    mean(CIVED_1999$voto, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(ICCS_2009$voto, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(ICCS_2016$voto, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(PACES_2019$voto, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# Ordenar las bases cronológicamente en el eje X
promedios_voto$base <- factor(promedios_voto$base,
                               levels = c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019"))

# --- Gráfico de barras ----------------------------------------------------
ggplot(promedios_voto, aes(x = base, y = promedio)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(promedio, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Promedio de voto por base de datos",
    x = "Base de datos (año)",
    y = "Promedio de voto"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)


```

### Gráfico promedio de variables contextos

#### Clima aula
```{r}

promedio_clima_aula <- data.frame(
  base = c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019"),
  promedio = c(
    mean(CIVED_1999$clima_aula_escuela, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(ICCS_2009$clima_aula_escuela, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(ICCS_2016$clima_aula_escuela, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(PACES_2019$clima_aula_escuela, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# Ordenar las bases cronológicamente en el eje X
promedio_clima_aula$base <- factor(promedio_clima_aula$base,
                               levels = c("CIVED_1999", "ICCS_2009", "ICCS_2016", "PACES_2019"))


ggplot(promedio_clima_aula, aes(x = base, y = promedio)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(promedio, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Promedio de indice clima del aula por base de datos",
    x = "Base de datos (año)",
    y = "Promedio del clima del aula"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
